channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Europe, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Europe, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Humboldt Residency Programme 2027, "Oceanic Horizons: The Future of our Blue Planet" (funded six-week residency for researchers, creatives and practitioners) (closes 14 Dec)
item.description:
Alexander von Humboldt Foundation
Deadline: 14 Dec 2026
Award: Monthly allowance for the six-week residency (figure not published: researchers get standard Humboldt fellowship rates, creatives and practitioners a competitive honorarium), travel allowance to and from Germany, accommodation at Schloss Wiepersdorf and a Berlin aparthotel, and a budget for public formats. No family allowance. No application fee.

Each year the Humboldt Foundation brings twelve people from research, the arts and civil society together to work on one topic and find new ways of communicating it to audiences beyond academia. The 2027 topic is Oceanic Horizons: The Future of our Blue Planet.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: RIXC Northern Climate Practices: art-science residencies in Latvia 2027-2028 for Nordic and Baltic artists (EUR 3,000 stipend, fully funded) (closes 31 Dec)
item.description:
RIXC Center for New Media Culture
Deadline: 31 Dec 2026
Award: EUR 3,000 artist stipend, EUR 600 food allowance, EUR 250 local travel allowance and EUR 500 for production materials per residency. Accommodation provided and international travel fully reimbursed. No application fee mentioned.

RIXC, the Riga centre for new media culture, offers five fully funded two-month residencies under the title Northern Climate Practices, supported by the Nordic-Baltic Mobility Programme for Culture. WHO: professional artists from the Nordic and Baltic countries.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Nous les sols: six-month participatory production residency at La Citadelle de Marseille (EUR 11,000 in fees plus up to EUR 5,000 production) (closes 3 Jan 2027)
item.description:
La Citadelle de Marseille (supported by the Fondation Daniel et Nina Carasso)
Deadline: 3 Jan 2027
Award: EUR 9,000 excl. tax artist fee for the whole period, plus EUR 1,400 for the co-creation workshops and EUR 600 for community meetings and advocacy events (EUR 11,000 in fees), and a production grant of up to EUR 5,000 excl. tax. A workspace and a further EUR 5,000 budget for guest speakers and event materials are covered by the Citadelle. For a duo or collective the fees are paid once, not per person. No application fee stated.

La Citadelle de Marseille, the association running the 17th-century Fort d'Entrecasteaux as a heritage third place, is selecting one artist (or duo or collective) for Nous les sols, the second edition of its work on polluted and regenerating soils following the European programme Common Grounds.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Centre Culturel Irlandais, Paris: Artist Residency Programme 2027 (opens 2 December; EUR 800 a month plus travel and accommodation) (closes 14 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Centre Culturel Irlandais (Paris)
Deadline: 14 Jan 2027
Award: Stipend of EUR 800 a month, accommodation at the Centre, and return travel reimbursed up to EUR 300. No application fee stated.

The Irish cultural centre in Paris hosts artists in residence each year, funded by Ireland's Department of Foreign Affairs. NOT YET OPEN: the call opens on 2 December 2026 and closes on 14 January 2027.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Planetary Transitions 2027: Potsdam Artist Residency (EUR 2,500/month, 4 to 6 months at a sustainability research institute) (closes 7 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Research Institute for Sustainability (RIFS) at GFZ, with the City of Potsdam and the DAAD Artists-in-Berlin Program
Deadline: 7 Feb 2027
Award: Monthly stipend of EUR 2,500, plus a lump sum for travel to Potsdam and back, and up to EUR 5,000 housing support if you stay in Potsdam. No application fee stated.

An art-science residency that brings an international artist into the Research Institute for Sustainability (RIFS) in Potsdam to work alongside researchers on sustainability and planetary transitions. Run since 2025 by RIFS at GFZ, the City of Potsdam and the DAAD Artists-in-Berlin Program.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Saari Residence 2028 (Kone Foundation, Finland; monthly grant plus housing and workspace) (closes 31 Mar 2027)
item.description:
Kone Foundation, Saari Residence
Deadline: 31 Mar 2027, 16:00 EEST
Award: Monthly grant for living, travel and other costs, plus accommodation and workspace. The 2028 figure is not yet published; the 2027 cycle paid EUR 2,700, 3,200 or 3,800 per month depending on career stage. No application fee.

Saari Residence is the Kone Foundation's residency in rural southwest Finland, applied for a year in advance. Residents get housing, a workspace and a monthly grant (EUR 2,700 to 3,800 per month in the 2027 cycle, depending on career stage; 2028 figures not yet published).

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Schloss Wiepersdorf Individual and Collaborative Fellowships 2028 (Brandenburg; EUR 1,200/month plus room and board) (closes 15 Apr 2027)
item.description:
Schloss Wiepersdorf (state of Brandenburg)
Deadline: 15 Apr 2027, 23:59 CEST
Award: EUR 1,200 per month stipend, a one-time EUR 480 material grant, room and board, and German visa costs where needed. No application fee.

Three-month residential fellowships at Schloss Wiepersdorf for artists, writers, composers and scholars from Germany and abroad. Fellows get room, board, a EUR 1,200 monthly stipend and a material grant; fine artists get a studio where space allows.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Democracy Foundation: Democracy Residency 'European Dream' 2027 (Kuldiga, Latvia; Liepaja European Capital of Culture) (closes 15 Nov)
item.description:
Democracy Foundation (Kuldiga), part of the Liepaja 2027 European Capital of Culture programme
Deadline: 15 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 1,000 stipend per participant (covering expenses during the residency, including travel), plus up to EUR 1,000 per participant to develop and run their activity, and accommodation in Kuldiga's Old Town. Six participants. No application fee stated.

International interdisciplinary residency run by the Democracy Foundation in Kuldiga, Latvia, as part of the Liepaja 2027 European Capital of Culture programme.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Futures of Listening x Immersive Audio Network: Residency Open Call (Bristol, IAN Festival 2027) (closes 21 Nov)
item.description:
Futures of Listening (FIBER, 4DSOUND, Robin Koek, Art of Sound) and the Immersive Audio Network (IAN)
Deadline: 21 Nov 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: EUR 1,750 residency fee (excl. VAT, paid on invoice), plus return travel from the Netherlands to Bristol and private accommodation for 22 to 30 January 2027. No application fee.

One residency for a freelance audio practitioner (composer, sound designer, audio maker, artist or researcher) registered in the Netherlands, to develop an existing project into a spatial, story-led sound work.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: MON-ART: Nicosia Monastery of Arts Residency 2027, art, sustainability and community (Cyprus, EUR 6,000 fee) (closes 23 Nov)
item.description:
Visual Voices (MON-ART project, co-funded by Creative Europe)
Deadline: 23 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 6,000 artist fee per artist, plus EUR 1,400 production costs, travel (EUR 600-1,000) and shared accommodation. Two artists selected. No application fee stated.

Visual Voices invites artists working at the intersection of art, sustainability and community life to the Nicosia Monastery of Arts Residency in Nicosia, Cyprus.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Follow Fluxus: After Fluxus Scholarship 2026/27 (EUR 10,000, 3-month studio and exhibition, Wiesbaden)
item.description: Nassauischer Kunstverein Wiesbaden, with the City of Wiesbaden · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · EUR 10,000 grant plus a rent-free 70.88 sqm live/work studio at the Kunsthaus Wiesbaden for three months and a follow-up exhibition at the Nassauischer Kunstverein. No application fee mentioned.

item.title: HIAP x Sumud: Residency for Palestinian Artists in Helsinki, Spring 2027 (EUR 3,600 working grant)
item.description: HIAP Helsinki International Artist Programme, with Sumud - The Finnish Palestine Network · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · EUR 3,600 working grant, a free 63 sqm live/work studio, one return trip, and a visa budget covering application fees and visa-office travel. No application fee.

item.title: TRACES Art & Science @ Energypolis 2027: residency at the EPFL Laboratory for Energy Materials (Sion)
item.description: Foundation for the Sustainable Development of Mountain Regions (FDDM) with EPFL Valais-Wallis · deadline 22 Nov 2026 · Artist stipend of CHF 2,000 per month (CHF 6,000 total) covering living and research costs, housing in Sion, travel from home and back up to CHF 1,500, and a separate production budget set by the curator. No application fee.
